calls.head: Expect the Penguins to have the puck more
calls.body: At 5-on-5, the Penguins have been near the top of the league at getting more of the chances than they give up, and the Predators near the bottom. The ice should tilt the Penguins’ way, even if goaltending and bounces have the final say on the score.

calls.head: The Penguins hunt better looks than the Predators
calls.body: The Penguins wait for good looks, but the Predators settle for hopeful ones. Pittsburgh is one of the league’s best for shot quality, and Nashville is near the bottom. The more dangerous chances should be the Penguins’.

surprises.head: Both teams played to type
surprises.body: Nothing in this game strayed far from how these two usually play: the shot share, the quality of chances, special teams, hitting, ice time and goaltending all landed inside their normal night-to-night range.

story.head: Koivunen wins it in overtime
paras: Steven Stamkos got the scoring started for the Predators midway through the first, but Connor Dewar made it 1-1 for Pittsburgh just 18 seconds into the second. Jayden Struble scored his first goal for Nashville early in the second to put the Predators back ahead 2-1. With the goalie pulled and just over a minute left, Rickard Rakell tied it 2-2 for Pittsburgh. Ville Koivunen won it in overtime.

The Penguins carried the play, outshooting the Predators 37-26, but needed overtime to win it. Artūrs Šilovs made 24 saves for the Penguins, and Juuse Saros kept the Preds in it, stopping 34 of 37. Nobody on the ice had a bigger night than Elmer Söderblom, even with Koivunen’s overtime winner in the game, by our Swing measure.

Only two penalties were called all night, something the league sees about once every 20 games. The Penguins improved to 5-6-1, sixth in the Metropolitan, while the Predators fell to 3-3-4, seventh in the Central.

items.text: Steven Stamkos scored again against Pittsburgh, and has six goals in eight games against them since 2023-24.
Reid Schaefer was in NHL.com’s projected lineup, but Vitali Pinchuk played instead.
Both of the preview’s calls held.
